  20260703-094500-d-prc-cap process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The capture procedure is the shared spine for recording signals and decisions: assemble a graph-grounded draft, play it back for explicit user confirmation, write through the pre-flight gate whose override only the user can choose, then verify the generated summary for fidelity.   20260703-190000-d-prc-eng process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The engage procedure is the universal entry move for working on a specific entry: establish the anchor (plus connected targets), receive the full chains served at the brief step, synthesize a brief shaped by the anchor's kind and the user's goal, then put the candidate moves to the user at the junction. The picked move runs as its own procedure — engage ends by dispatching, not by acting.
  20260703-190100-d-prc-exp process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The explore procedure is a compression mission over a set of entries: read the whole surface in a disposable context — chains served in full, every pointer that could bear on the goal inspected via show, iterating until nothing new surfaces — then compress toward the goal into a briefing that keeps full IDs and enough context for the outer dialogue to act without re-reading. Designed to be dispatched to a sub-agent; the goal carries the dialogue context across that boundary.
  20260703-194500-d-prc-cat process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The catch-up procedure produces the check-in briefing: the engine injects the catch-up lanes fresh (focus, recent done, active-and-hot, open loops, open-and-warm, WIP) as one multi-section view, the agent composes a colleague-style briefing threaded by story arc, and the check-in ends in a user junction — what to move forward is the user's pick, relayed verbatim, with follow-up moves dispatched as their own procedures.
  20260703-200000-d-prc-evl process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The evaluate procedure treats evaluation as real work: scope which lenses this run covers — inner is verification, outer is validation, their concrete meaning defined by the project — carry the judgment out with evidence, and end in a user junction where the evaluation is recorded as a done signal with findings surfaced by it, keeping per-lens coverage computable across the graph.
  20260704-100000-d-prc-dlg process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The user-dialogue shell is the session base: auto-started by the session door, its opening serve carries the compressed SDD process core, conduct and register rules, the live move enumeration, session info, and routing guidance.   20260706-170000-d-prc-imp process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The implementation procedure runs committed work as a working loop around host work: a served contract with a readiness escape, a user-chosen run mode with an engine-created WIP marker, per-slice progress check-ins with a dialogue-first blocked path, and an ordered closeout that records the hash-citing closing done, removes the marker, and offers a seeded evaluation.
  20260706-171500-d-prc-grm process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The groom procedure returns the graph to a clean state without deciding anything new: sweep for non-clean constellations — resolved-but-open entries, stale WIP markers, superseded-in-practice content, strained directive pairs, procedure forks — present them as a numbered candidate table with evidence and proposed cleanups, then walk the table with the user, dispatching each agreed cleanup as an ordinary seeded capture.
  20260706-180000-d-prc-int process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The interview procedure builds shared understanding as a researched question loop: journalist posture with the user as the expert, exactly one pressure-tested, background-balanced question per turn, each answer grounded back in the graph to connect or push back, a running transcript as alignment evidence and resume material, closing with a synthesis whose crystallized outcomes become seeded captures at a user junction.

  20260829-200554-d-stg-0nd strategic aspiration decision [confidence: medium] (Felix) {status: active} <area-product, audience> sddviz exists to make a project's recorded reasoning accessible to people away from a terminal — project leads, strategists, project owners and UI/UX experts — who are poorly served by today's agent-mediated reading of an SDD graph, which demands a terminal, an agent session, and fluency in the tool's vocabulary. The aspiration is that any such person can open the graph and follow what was decided and why on their own. It sets no completion criterion; instead it becomes the standing test against which later decisions about the viewer's content, navigation, and on-screen vocabulary are weighed.
